description: Frozen, post-freeze diagnostics on exposed first-eligible observations and original parent entry opportunities; no threshold search.
state_encoder: experiments.capacity.neuron.encode(bars), run independently per New York session.

first_eligible_method.input_rows: Canonical experiments/hold_work/results/first-decisions.csv.gz; all reference labels, first eligible per trade/delay.
first_eligible_method.join: panel, date, decision bar_start; original replay forecast must equal fresh neuron reservoir output within 1e-9 points.
first_eligible_method.label: realized_hold_pts from the canonical file, signed in MNQ points from the alternate executable open to frozen original exit.

metrics.price_stress_margin: A * (side * price_forecast - SHOCK * scale * price_stock); matches the frozen price_long/short output.
metrics.volume_stress_margin: A * (side * parent_forecast_points - SHOCK * scale * observed_volume_stock); true observed-charge margin, matching frozen hold_long/short.

first_eligible_method.ranks: Percentile ranks within panel/date/delay, retained per observation in first-decisions.csv.gz.

entry_signal_method.input_rows: All frozen original parent trades, both delays and both source families.
entry_signal_method.join: Encoder states at each original signal_time, before entry fill.
entry_signal_method.label: signed_gross_parent_points = side * (original exit - original entry), independently verified against gross_usd at $2/point.
entry_signal_method.fixed_filter: keep iff true parent volume_stress_margin > 0 on the original signal bar; rejected iff <= 0; no threshold sweep.

paired_block_bootstrap.scheme: paired source-level trade-weighted Spearman rank differences; 5-session circular blocks sampled within each panel, with a common resample for all metrics.
